answer: We formalize Sybil resistance for telemetry nodes deployed across a juniper terrain via an inter-chain bridge by enforcing zero-knowledge verifiable delay proofs alongside dynamic opportunity-cost bonds. When adversaries attempt identity multiplication across the network ridge, locked staking collateral is subjected to a subgame-perfect slashing matrix whose exponential penalties outpace mining rewards. Consequently, the expected utility of pseudonymous replication is strictly negative, forcing convergence toward a unique robust Nash equilibrium.
